columns.name: owner_name
columns.description: Name of the owner of the restaurant.

columns.name: num_high_risk_violations
columns.description: The number of high-risk violations the restaurant has, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_of_inspections_because_of_complaint
columns.description: The number of inspections the restaurant has because of a complaint, replace NULL values with 0. Because of a complaint refers to type = 'Complaint'.

columns.name: violation_per_inspection
columns.description: The average number of violations per inspection the restaurant has.

columns.name: lowest_inspection_score
columns.description: The lowest inspection score the restaurant has.

columns.name: meets_all_required_standards_for_4_consecutive_years
columns.description: 1 if there exists a run of 4 or more consecutive calendar years in which every year of the run contains at least one inspection with score = 100. Otherwise 0.
